purpose: LPC-only source registry for Havenwild runtime/editor art.

sources.author: Eliza Wyatt (DeathsDarling), Lanea Zimmerman (Sharm), LPC contributors
sources.recommendedUse: primary project-wide runtime/editor art foundation; route through the ElizaWy domain catalogs, then promote by explicit source rects and authored LPC roles
sources.prohibitedUse: do not guess runtime semantics from filenames alone; review footprints/autotile roles before promotion
notes: Pinned source is mirrored under assets/source/licensed/lpc_revised.

sources.displayName: [LPC Revised] Fully Configured 4-Seasons Tilesets for Tiled Map Editor
sources.author: JaidynReiman
sources.rawAssetPolicy: metadata_donor_archive_quarantine_only; compiled donor atlas is not Havenwild art authority
sources.recommendedUse: relationship-evidence donor for the existing Havenwild Tiled importer; use Wang/terrain sets, properties, animation and collision metadata to help map the original pinned ElizaWy source, while keeping ElizaWy/LPC as immutable art authority
sources.prohibitedUse: do not replace original ElizaWy source pixels; do not make donor collision authoritative for gameplay; do not promote the compiled 2048x2048 donor atlas as Havenwild cliff identity
notes: Release page lists CC-BY 3.0 and OGA-BY 3.0.
Author states the pack compiles existing LPC Revised exterior assets and configures Tiled Terrain Sets where possible, plus animation and collision.
Havenwild consumes this as metadata evidence only.
